General Contracting in Temple, TX & Bell County

Your trusted single point of contact for repairs, renovations, painting, roofing, additions, and custom projects. We coordinate everything so you don’t have to.

What We Handle

  • General repairs and maintenance for homes and small commercial
  • Painting, roofing, and finish work
  • Storm damage restoration and insurance claims
  • Additions, structural work, and major remodels
  • Coordination of specialty trades (electrical, plumbing, HVAC)
  • Commercial, church, and facility projects

Local Considerations

We know the realities of building in Bell County—expansive clay soils, intense heat, sudden storms, and older housing stock. Our estimates account for these conditions from day one. We use materials and methods proven in Central Texas.

Our Process

1

Free Consultation

Stage 1: Understanding Your Needs

We sit down with you—over coffee if you’re local—to understand the problem, your goals, and your budget. No pressure, just honest conversation.

Whether it’s a leaky faucet, a kitchen remodel, or a custom build, every project starts the same way: listening. We’ll assess the scope and give you a clear picture of what’s involved.

2

Assessment & Planning

Stage 2: Evaluating the Work & Creating a Plan

We inspect the site, measure twice, and develop a detailed plan tailored to your project—big or small.

For repairs, that means diagnosing the root cause. For renovations and builds, it means design options, material selections, and permits. We know Central Texas conditions inside out—clay soils, heat, drainage—and plan accordingly.

3

Transparent Proposal

Stage 3: Clear Pricing with No Surprises

You get a written proposal with a clear scope, honest pricing, and a clear, realistic timeline—before any work begins.

We don’t believe in hidden fees or vague estimates. You’ll know exactly what you’re paying for, when the work starts, and when it’ll be done.

4

Skilled Execution

Stage 4: Quality Work, Start to Finish

Our experienced team gets to work—with proper tools, quality materials, and the craftsmanship Central Texas has trusted for five generations.

From a single repair to a full renovation or custom build, every task is handled with precision. We keep a clean job site, communicate daily, and never cut corners.

5

Quality Check & Walkthrough

Stage 5: Making Sure It’s Right

Before we call it done, we inspect every detail. Then we walk through it with you—because it’s not finished until you’re satisfied.

We hold ourselves to a high standard. If something isn’t perfect, we fix it. Our goal is work you’ll be proud of for years to come.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a typical project take? Small repairs: 1–5 days. Larger remodels or additions: 2–6 weeks. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Do you handle insurance work? Yes. We work directly with adjusters and ensure proper documentation.

Do you pull permits? Yes, we handle all permitting and inspections for compliant work.

What if my project changes mid-way? We document changes in writing and adjust the scope and timeline accordingly.

How do you ensure quality across trades? We use trusted local partners and supervise all work on site.
